Name: bd.emlocal.m
Description: Monthly total return on emerging-market government bonds in local currency (J.P. Morgan GBI-EM), measured in US dollars, so it carries the currency risk. Built from 2 segments, newest first: EMLC (VanEck J.P. Morgan EM Local Currency Bond ETF: emerging-market government debt in local currency) 2010-08 to 2026-08; EMB (iShares J.P. Morgan USD Emerging Markets Bond ETF: emerging-market sovereign and quasi-sovereign debt issued in US dollars, so it carries credit risk but not local currency risk) 2008-01 to 2010-07. Each segment's own exposure applies over its span, and each earlier one was chosen by the smallest mean discrepancy over its overlap.

Name: bd.globalagg.m
Description: Monthly total return on investment-grade bonds outside the US, hedged to the US dollar. Built from 2 segments, newest first: BNDX (Vanguard Total International Bond ETF: investment-grade bonds outside the US, hedged to the US dollar, so it measures foreign rates without foreign currency) 2013-07 to 2026-08; AGG (iShares Core U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF: US investment-grade bonds: Treasuries, agency, corporate and mortgage-backed) 2003-10 to 2013-06. Each segment's own exposure applies over its span, and each earlier one was chosen by the smallest mean discrepancy over its overlap.

Name: bd.highyield.m
Description: Monthly total return on US sub-investment-grade corporate bonds, in US dollars. No earlier segment was joined: the series is HYG (iShares iBoxx $ High Yield Corporate Bond ETF: US sub-investment-grade corporate credit) alone, 2007-05 to 2026-08.

Name: bd.ustreasury.m
Description: Monthly total return on US Treasuries across the curve, one to thirty years, in US dollars. Built from 2 segments, newest first: GOVT (iShares U.S. Treasury Bond ETF: US Treasuries across the whole curve, one to thirty years) 2012-03 to 2026-08; IEF (iShares 7-10 Year Treasury Bond ETF: intermediate US Treasuries) 2002-08 to 2012-02. Each segment's own exposure applies over its span, and each earlier one was chosen by the smallest mean discrepancy over its overlap.

Name: cboe.VXTH
Description: A hypothetical portfolio of the S&P 500 with dividends reinvested plus one-month VIX call options, bought monthly and sized by the level of the VIX. An equity holding with a tail hedge: it gives up a little in calm markets and gains when volatility spikes. Published by Cboe from 2006. Monthly total return from the month-end index level, in US dollars.

Name: cm.broad.m
Description: Monthly total return on broad commodity futures (S&P GSCI, production weighted and so energy heavy), in US dollars. Built from 2 segments, newest first: GSG (iShares S&P GSCI Commodity-Indexed Trust: broad commodity futures, production weighted and therefore heavily energy weighted) 2006-08 to 2026-08; DBC (Invesco DB Commodity Index Tracking Fund: broad commodity futures across energy, metals and agriculture) 2006-03 to 2006-07. Each segment's own exposure applies over its span, and each earlier one was chosen by the smallest mean discrepancy over its overlap.

Name: eq.acwi.m
Description: Monthly total return on large and mid-cap equity across developed and emerging markets, the MSCI ACWI universe, in US dollars. Built from 2 segments, newest first: ACWI (iShares MSCI ACWI ETF: large and mid-cap equity across 23 developed and 24 emerging markets) 2008-04 to 2026-08; SPY (SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust: US large-cap equity) 1993-02 to 2008-03. Each segment's own exposure applies over its span, and each earlier one was chosen by the smallest mean discrepancy over its overlap.

Name: eq.chinaA.m
Description: Monthly total return on mainland-listed China A-shares (CSI 300), the domestic market, in US dollars. Built from 3 segments, newest first: ASHR (Xtrackers Harvest CSI 300 China A-Shares ETF: mainland-listed A-shares, the domestic market rather than the offshore one) 2013-12 to 2026-08; GXC (SPDR S&P China ETF: broad Chinese equity across offshore-investable share classes) 2007-04 to 2013-11; FXI (iShares China Large-Cap ETF: the fifty largest Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong) 2004-11 to 2007-03. Each segment's own exposure applies over its span, and each earlier one was chosen by the smallest mean discrepancy over its overlap. Smoothing was applied at the joint to GXC.

Name: eq.china.m
Description: Monthly total return on Chinese equity in the share classes open to foreign investors, in US dollars. Built from 3 segments, newest first: MCHI (iShares MSCI China ETF: broad China equity across all share classes available to foreigners) 2011-04 to 2026-08; GXC (SPDR S&P China ETF: broad Chinese equity across offshore-investable share classes) 2007-04 to 2011-03; FXI (iShares China Large-Cap ETF: the fifty largest Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong) 2004-11 to 2007-03. Each segment's own exposure applies over its span, and each earlier one was chosen by the smallest mean discrepancy over its overlap.

Name: eq.europe.m
Description: Monthly total return on European large-cap equity across developed markets, in US dollars. No earlier segment was joined: the series is IEV (iShares Europe ETF: european large-cap equity across 16 developed markets) alone, 2000-08 to 2026-08.

Name: eq.india.m
Description: Monthly total return on Indian equity, in US dollars. Built from 3 segments, newest first: INDA (iShares MSCI India ETF: indian large and mid-cap equity) 2012-03 to 2026-08; EPI (WisdomTree India Earnings Fund: indian equity weighted by earnings rather than market capitalisation) 2008-03 to 2012-02; IFN (abrdn India Fund: closed-end Indian equity fund) 1994-03 to 2008-02. Each segment's own exposure applies over its span, and each earlier one was chosen by the smallest mean discrepancy over its overlap. Smoothing was applied at the joint to IFN.

Name: eq.world.m
Description: Monthly total return on developed-market large and mid-cap equity, the MSCI World universe, in US dollars. Built from 3 segments, newest first: URTH (iShares MSCI World ETF: large and mid-cap equity across developed markets only, no emerging) 2012-02 to 2026-08; ACWI (iShares MSCI ACWI ETF: large and mid-cap equity across 23 developed and 24 emerging markets) 2008-04 to 2012-01; SPY (SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust: US large-cap equity) 1993-02 to 2008-03. Each segment's own exposure applies over its span, and each earlier one was chosen by the smallest mean discrepancy over its overlap.

Name: fx.EURCHF
Description: Price of one euro in Swiss francs at the last trading day of the month. With the dollar rate it spans CHF, EUR and USD, so any of the three can be converted into any other.

Name: fx.USDCHF
Description: Price of one US dollar in Swiss francs at the last trading day of the month. Used to read USD-quoted proxy returns in CHF or EUR, and CHF returns in USD, at the point of use.

Name: long.ag
Description: Value of US farm business, annual, held from 1910 to 2020 (census, then FRED). The source is sparse before 1910 and those years are dropped, not filled. The agriculture return of block 7.

Name: long.bill
Description: Annual return on holding US Treasury bills, 1870 to 2020, as a decimal. Macrohistory, then FRED. The cash return of block 1 and the financial sentiment component.

Name: long.bond
Description: US long-term government bond yield, annual 1870 to 2020, as a decimal, from the Macrohistory database. A yield, not a holding return: the holding return is long.bondtr. Block 2.

Name: long.bondtr
Description: Annual total return on US government bonds, 1871 to 2015, as a decimal (Macrohistory, then Macrotrends). Ends in 2015. Block 4.

Name: long.broad
Description: US broad money stock in current US dollars, full units, annual 1870 to 2020. Joined from Macrohistory and FRED. Input to the monetary composition indicator.

Name: long.cpi
Description: US consumer price inflation, annual 1870 to 2020, as a decimal rate rather than a price level. Macrohistory, then FRED. The deflator for real terms.

Name: long.erng
Description: US wage earnings index, annual 1870 to 2020, joined from census, FRED and an earlier historical earnings index.

Name: long.gdp
Description: US nominal GDP in current US dollars, full units (not billions), annual 1870 to 2020. Joined from the Macrohistory database and FRED. The denominator of debt saturation.

Name: long.gold
Description: Gold price on the New York market in US dollars per fine ounce, annual 1870 to 2020. Log-differenced into the return of block 6.

Name: long.gov_debt
Description: US federal government debt outstanding in current US dollars, full units, annual 1870 to 2020. Joined from census.gov historical statistics and FRED.

Name: long.house
Description: US house price index, annual 1890 to 2020, joined from Piketty's series and FRED. Starts in 1890. The real estate return of block 8.

Name: long.loans
Description: US bank loans outstanding in current US dollars, full units, annual 1870 to 2020. Joined from census historical statistics and FRED.

Name: long.lrate
Description: US 10-year Treasury yield, annual 1870 to 2020, as a decimal. Joined from Macrohistory and FRED. The long leg of the yield curve.

Name: long.narrow
Description: US narrow money stock in current US dollars, full units, annual 1870 to 2020. Joined from Macrohistory and FRED. Input to the monetary composition indicator.

Name: long.oil
Description: Crude oil price in US dollars per barrel, annual 1870 to 2020 (EIA, then FRED). Half of the commodity block, with wheat.

Name: long.spx
Description: S&P US stock index level, annual 1870 to 2020 (4.44 in 1870). Log-differenced into the equity return of block 3.

Name: long.srate
Description: US 1-year Treasury bill rate, annual 1870 to 2020, as a decimal (0.0572 is 5.72 %). Joined from Macrohistory and FRED. The short leg of the yield curve.

Name: long.ump
Description: US unemployment rate, annual 1870 to 2020, as a decimal (0.0352 is 3.52 %). Joined from Vernon's historical estimates, census and FRED.

Name: long.wheat
Description: US wheat price in US dollars, annual 1870 to 2020 (census, then Macrotrends). Half of the commodity block, with oil.

Name: fmre.calibration
Description: One row per calibration run: its identifier, when it ran, and the source checksums that make it reproducible.

Name: fmre.calibration_block
Description: The 25-state return profile for each of the eight asset blocks, with the method label on every state.

Name: fmre.calibration_role
Description: The four role profiles -- gain, income, stabilisation, protection -- averaged at phase level and interpolated across the state axis.

Name: fmre.environment_indicator
Description: The eight standardised, de-trended indicators the cycle is built from, per year.

Name: fmre.instrument
Description: The instrument register. Expandable by data change rather than code change.

Name: fmre.instrument_profile
Description: The estimated 25-state profile per instrument per calibration, carrying the method behind each value and the coverage grade of the weakest one.

Name: fmre.instrument_return
Description: Monthly returns per instrument, the evidence every estimated profile is built from.

Name: fmre.long_series
Description: The long annual record behind Steiner (2021): nineteen series, 1870 onwards.

Name: fmre.market_environment
Description: The composite economic cycle value per year, and the phase it was classified into.

Name: fmre.market_risk_month
Description: Each month's summary reading of that distribution, so consumers need not re-reduce the distribution themselves.

Name: fmre.market_risk_signal
Description: The monthly Market Risk Signal as a 25-state distribution. Read by reference, never recomputed here.

Name: fmre.run_manifest
Description: What each run produced. No figure leaves an engine without one.

Name: fmre.source_file
Description: Provenance for the files this engine loads directly, pending its migration to reading the feed.

Name: fmre.state_map
Description: The quantile bridge mapping the monthly signal onto the annual calibration axis.

Name: fmre.state_map_meta
Description: The quantiles and bounds that define that bridge.

Name: fmre_feed.observation
Description: Every value the feed holds, each flagged observed, carried or stitched. A panel is assembled from here and never invents a cell.

Name: fmre_feed.reference_source
Description: The Notion Data Sources catalogue mirrored into SQL, each entry tagged with whether an engine actually reads it and which -- a bibliography and a dependency list look identical until something breaks.

Name: fmre_feed.series_definition
Description: The registry. One row per series with the metadata that makes its numbers safe to combine: unit, currency, magnitude, period, country, and how far it can be trusted.

Name: fmre_feed.series_segment
Description: The joints of a stitched series: which source covered which span, the overlap, the mean discrepancy that won it, and whether smoothing fired above the 2% threshold.

Name: fmre_feed.snapshot
Description: An immutable, checksummed manifest of the whole feed at a point in time. The reference every downstream golden test pins itself to.

Name: fmre_feed.snapshot_series
Description: Per-series coverage and checksum inside one snapshot.

Name: fmre_feed.source_file
Description: Provenance for every file loaded into the feed: SHA-256, byte size, the absolute path the bytes were read from, and whether that path was the NAS or the internet.

Description: eigentlich: engine inputs finalised by a curator per client and engine (e.g. pcp-mandate@1.0.0), a linear chain through supersedes_id; append-only. K2.

Name: eigentlich.position
Description: eigentlich: plan table (C-09). A position in the role grid (human or financial capital); deactivated, never deleted. K2.

Name: eigentlich.report
Description: eigentlich: a report produced for a request, with the report engine's artefact id and the LBS and Allocation artefacts it rests on; append-only. K2.

Name: eigentlich.report_request
Description: eigentlich: a request for a report or an update; withdrawal (withdrawn_at, set once, only while unfulfilled) is the only update. K2.

Name: eigentlich.submission
Description: eigentlich: intake files as received, whole (A154), unique per client and content hash; append-only. K3.

Name: eigentlich.thread
Description: eigentlich: a client's question thread; closing (closed_at, set once) is the only update. K2.

Name: eigentlich.thread_message
Description: eigentlich: messages in a thread by the client, a curator or spark7 (the ChatBot, with model, artefact id, sources and unverified numbers); append-only. K2.

Name: lbs.artefact
Description: lbs: published LifeBalanceSheets (lbs-balance-sheet) per opaque client_ref, keyed by content hash and unique on idempotency key; append-only

Name: lbs.calibration
Description: lbs: versioned parameter sets (the prototype content records with their approval metadata, and the mandate policy figures); append-only

Name: lbs.run
Description: lbs: one row per POST /run attempt, with status, gaps, coverage and provenance

Name: report.artefact
Description: report: published reports (report@1.0.0), every figure with its source artefact, the checked prose and the rendered HTML; one complete report per idempotency key; append-only

Name: report.calibration
Description: report: versioned parameter sets (prose generation, number check, reject rules, listing threshold, section asks); append-only

Name: report.run
Description: report: one row per POST /run or POST /report attempt, with status, warnings and provenance
